name: Wood Elves
source: Warhammer Armies: Wood Elves (4th edition, 1996), army list pp.60-69, special characters pp.70-80 (book page numbers)
keywordsSource: Special rule keywords from the Wood Elf army list and reference sheet (p.81)

rules.message: The army must be led by one General (p.64).
Only one Battle Standard is allowed (p.64).
One Treeman for every full 1,000 points of the army (p.68).

entries.name: Wood Elf General
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Battle Standard of Athel Loren
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: His one magic item may be a magic standard (p.64).

entries.name: Wood Elf Hero
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Wood Elf Mage
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: A Mage wearing armour cannot cast spells; a barded steed does not matter (p.65).

entries.name: Wood Elf Chariots
entries.equipmentText: Crew: hand weapon, light armour; two Elven Steeds
entries.rulesText: Chariot, No move through woods
entries.notes: Barding costs 4 per steed (enter the number of steeds). A chariot ridden by a character has no extra crewman. One chariot may carry a magic standard. A unit's Champion rides in a chariot as a third crewman (+76) (pp.65-66).

entries.name: Glade Riders
entries.rulesText: Skirmish (with bows), Feigned flight, Move through woods without penalty (skirmishing)
entries.notes: One unit of Glade Riders may carry a magic standard (p.66).

entries.name: Warhawk Riders
entries.rulesText: Fly, Skirmish

entries.name: Wardancers
entries.rulesText: Immune to psychology, Unmodified 6+ save (dodge), Spells dispelled on 4+, Wardances, Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Wood Elf Archers
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Glade Guard
entries.rulesText: Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Waywatchers
entries.rulesText: Skirmish, Hide in woods, Special deployment, Traps, Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Wood Elf Scouts
entries.rulesText: Skirmish, Special deployment, Move through woods without penalty

entries.name: Treemen
entries.rulesText: Fear, Woody skin (unmodified 5+), Double wounds from fire, Hate Orcs & Goblins, Rooted to the spot, Tree whack, Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: One Treeman for every full 1,000 points of the army; points count as Regiments. Treemen fight as individual models (p.68).

entries.name: Dryads
entries.rulesText: Save 5+ (also against spells and magic weapons), Shapeshifting, Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: Dryads have no champion of their own; Drycha may lead a unit (p.69).

entries.name: Great Eagle
entries.rulesText: Fly

entries.name: Orion, King in the Woods
entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, Spear of Kurnous, Horn of the Wild Hunt, Cloak of Isha
entries.rulesText: Fear, Wild charge (+D6), Immune to psychology, Divine aura (4+ against spells), Cloak of Isha (4+ special save)
entries.notes: 300 points plus Spear of Kurnous 50, Horn of the Wild Hunt 50 and Cloak of Isha 50 (p.70). He replaces the General. Add his Baying Hounds as a separate entry (5 points each).

entries.name: Orion's Baying Hounds
entries.notes: Any number of hounds at 5 points each, paid from the Characters allowance; they form one unit with Orion (p.71).

entries.name: Ariel, Mage Queen of Loren
entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, Wand of Wych Elm, Acorns of the Oak of Ages, Dart of Doom, Berry Wine
entries.rulesText: Mage Lord (High or Battle Magic), Fly, Divine aura (4+ against spells), Screech (no armour save), Dodge 4+
entries.notes: 366 points plus Wand of Wych Elm 50, Acorns 25, Dart of Doom 25 and Berry Wine 25 (pp.71-72).

entries.name: Naieth the Prophetess
entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, Rod of Divination, Othu the Owl
entries.rulesText: Level 1 wizard (Battle Magic), Rod of Divination (+1 magic card), Othu the Owl
entries.notes: 59 points plus Othu the Owl 15 and Rod of Divination 30 (p.74).

entries.name: Thalandor 'Doom Star'
entries.equipmentText: Sword, Spear of Daith, Magic War Paint, Talisman of Qwarr; rides Gwandor the Great Eagle
entries.rulesText: Master Mage (Battle Magic), War paint (3+ against missiles, 5+ in combat), Spear of Daith (parry 4+), Gwandor 4+ save
entries.notes: 240 points plus Magic War Paint 5, Talisman of Qwarr 15, Spear of Daith 25 and Gwandor 95 (p.75).

entries.name: Lothlann the Brave
entries.equipmentText: Sword, light armour, shield, Battle Standard of Athel Loren; barded Elven Steed
entries.rulesText: Battle Standard of Athel Loren (spells within 12" fizzle on 5+)
entries.notes: 101 points plus the Standard of Athel Loren 50 and barded Elven Steed 7 (p.76). He replaces the Battle Standard Bearer.

entries.name: Durthu the Treeman
entries.rulesText: Fear, Swarm of Sprites (D6 S3 hits, 12"), Hate Orcs, Goblins & Dwarfs, Tree whack, Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: May be taken in addition to the one Treeman per 1,000 points (p.76).

entries.name: Scarloc

attachTo.label: Champion of
attachTo.requiredMessage: Scarloc is the Champion of a unit of Scouts

entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, light armour, shield, longbow, Hail of Doom Arrow
entries.rulesText: Hail of Doom Arrow (3D6 S4 magic arrows, once)
entries.notes: 54 points plus the Hail of Doom Arrow 25 (p.77). He is the unit's Champion, so don't also give the unit a normal one.

entries.name: Wychwethyl the Wild

attachTo.label: Champion of
attachTo.requiredMessage: Wychwethyl is the Champion of a unit of Wardancers

entries.equipmentText: Two hand weapons, Drum of Orcskin
entries.rulesText: Immune to psychology, Choose opponent, Dance of Doom (once), Dodge 5+, Drum of Orcskin (+D6 charge)
entries.notes: 75 points plus the Drum of Orcskin 25 (pp.77-78). He is the unit's Champion, so don't also give the unit a normal one.

entries.name: Sceolan
entries.equipmentText: Sword, longbow, light armour, Buckler of Bronze, Bow of Loren
entries.rulesText: Buckler of Bronze, Bow of Loren (36", 3 magic shots at S4)
entries.notes: 106 points plus Buckler of Bronze 10 and Bow of Loren 50 (p.78).

entries.name: The Dryad Drycha

attachTo.label: Champion of
attachTo.requiredMessage: Drycha is the Champion of a unit of Dryads

entries.rulesText: Save 4+ (also against spells and magic weapons), Immune to psychology, Song of dread, Shapeshifting, Move through woods without penalty
entries.notes: Drycha leads a unit of Dryads as its Champion (p.78).

entries.name: Skaw the Falconer
entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, three falcons, Flail of Claws, feather cape
entries.rulesText: Falcons (24", three S3 hits, may pick characters), Flail of Claws (strikes first)
entries.notes: 51 points plus three falcons 15 and the Flail of Claws 25 (p.79). He may be the Champion of a unit of Warriors or Scouts, or an independent character.

entries.name: Gruarth the Beastmaster
entries.equipmentText: Hand weapon, beast cape, Binding Bolas; Fang and Claw, two sabre-toothed tigers
entries.rulesText: Immune to panic, Tigers stay within 12", Hates the enemy if both tigers are slain
entries.notes: 90 points plus two Sabre-toothed Tigers 66 and the Binding Bolas 10 (p.80).
